The new application will need your age proof and your other details again, and the mobile number will need to be free for the new filing.

Do you want me to withdraw SSP26734858 and start a new application with date of birth 04/03/1963? Please reply yes or no. If yes, I'll also need:

- Your village (the current one is Kakotibari, Sonari block) and bank account number, unless they are unchanged.
- Confirmation that the rest of the details are the same: full name Anjali Sonowal, village, and bank account.
